title: Normal ChIP H3K9ac in Primary Human Hepatocytes
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Resuspend 1 × 10⁶ isolated primary human hepatocytes in PBS and add formaldehyde to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v); incubate at room temperature for 14 min.

steps.title: Quench fixation with glycine
steps.instruction: Add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM; incubate for 1 min to quench the formaldehyde reaction.

steps.title: Wash cells with inhibitor‑supplemented PBS
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, cat 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat 303410); gently invert each wash.

steps.title: Harvest cells by scraping
steps.instruction: Scrape cells from the culture plates into cold PBS and collect the suspension.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to Covaris microtubes and sonicate on the Covaris E220 for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 %, 200 cycles/burst.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin concentration
steps.instruction: Measure chromatin DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and record the value.

steps.title: Perform immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine an equal amount of chromatin (as quantified) with 2 µg of the appropriate antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, cat 88802); incubate according to the standard ChIP protocol (no barcode ligation or pooling).

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: After IP and washes, elute DNA and measure its concentration with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Use the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLabs, cat E7645S) to construct libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Assess library quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of each library on an Agilent BioAnalyzer to evaluate fragment size distribution and quantify library concentration.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Pool libraries as needed and load onto an Illumina NovaSeq for paired‑end 150 bp sequencing.
